title.narrative: Nordic Civil Society Reception at Warsaw Human Dimension conference

description.narrative:
The Warsaw Human Dimension Conference is a 10-day OSCE event focused on promoting human rights, democracy and the rule of law. It brings together civil society organisations and human rights defenders from across the OSCE region alongside government representatives from participating States. The aim is to strengthen the capacity of civil society to engage in dialogue, exchange experiences, share good practices, and raise priority issues with the international community.
The civil society reception, traditionally held early in the conference, provides an important platform for organisations to establish connections and identify relevant contacts within state delegations. These initial exchanges help pave the way for more direct and effective dialogue throughout the remainder of the conference, thereby supporting long-term cooperation and impact.
The event has previously been hosted and funded by the US delegation that have chosen not to do so this year, instead the Nordic countries (except Finland who is currently the OSCE chair and therefor not in a position to host) have taken the initiative to host the event in order to preserve this valued and important space for civil society and emphasise the Nordic countries' strong support for civil society
